correctness.rationale: Norm preservation yields the exactly determined generating function Q via Hausdorff moments. Orthogonality produces finite-residue support via complex Hausdorff uniqueness and coefficientwise vanishing. A logarithmic-derivative residue at each nontrivial Nth root of unity forces integer alpha, and the consecutive support length forces alpha 0 or 1. Explicit telescoping norm identities with disjoint supports prove sufficiency; all hypotheses and N>=2 boundaries were checked. 7,106 exact finite checks supplement but do not replace this proof.

value.rationale: This is an exact complete classification of all possible analytic weights for a canonical noninjective holomorphic covering map on every standard Bergman Hilbert scale. The exceptional alpha=1 N-phase family is structurally distinct from the classical derivative-weight example, and the rigidity obstruction explains why no other power weight works. It answers a natural explicit gap left by broad transfer-measure criteria and is not an arbitrary finite or numerical slice.
